Previously known as Eyes On Optometrists, the practice has provided a high standard of eyecare solutions for the past 25 years. Our team of expert optometrists team have developed a loyal following in their local community and continue to deliver a unique optical and eyecare experience. Services Comprehensive eye tests Contact Lens Fitting including Orthokeratology OCT (Optical Coherence Tomography) scan technology and DRI (Digital Retinal Imaging) Low Vision Aid Visual Field Measurements Health Fund Instant Claims Advanced Dry Eye treatment including Dry Eye IPL therapy All major health funds accepted Bulk billing available at this practice IPL Therapy for Dry Eye IPL uses gentle pulses of light to address inflammation and encourage healthier gland function around the eyes. The result is improved tear stability and relief from many of the common symptoms of dry eye disease. OCT Eye Scans By generating highly detailed digital images, OCT technology helps detect changes in the eye with remarkable precision. This allows for earlier intervention and more informed treatment decisions. Contact Lens Consultations Our contact lens consultations are tailored to your vision needs, eye health and lifestyle. From first-time wearers to experienced users, we provide expert fitting, advice and ongoing support to help you achieve comfortable, clear vision.
